title: データサイエンス実践
subtitle: Advanced Data Science
keywords: machine learning 2.deep learning 3.image classification 4.natural language processing 5.Artificial Intelligence
educationalGoal: This course provides the principles and practices of advance methods of data science. Students learn AI (Artificial Intelligence) technology such as ensemble learning method and some kinds of deep learning methods. Students learn those method through the handouts with Python and Google Colaboratory.
advice: In recent years, mathematics, AI, and data science have attracted a great deal of attention of various fields. This course is especially designed for the students who have learned basic statistics. Students learn advanced data science techniques including deep learning methods. This course provides both classroom lectures and hands-on analysis exercises with Python and Google Colaboratory that are useful and use freeware tools for data analysis. Students learn theories, analytical skills, and some examples of business intelligence, which is considered to be the use of data in actual business. The instructor expect students to acquire the ability of data analysis trough this class to develop business in the future.
books: Textbooks: Yukinaga Azuma, Noble guidebook of artificial intelligence with Google Colaboratory, 2nd Edition (Google Colaboratoryで学ぶ! あたらしい人工知能技術の教科書 第2版), Shoueisha (ISBN:978-4798186092) (in Japanese language) Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Students are required to bring their own laptop computer to each class. The laptop PC needs to be able to install KNIME and Python with connecting to the Internet. Students are expected to understand basics of statistics and Python programming, so the instructor strongly recommend to take the course, "Statistics I", "Statistics II", "Algorithms and Data Structures", and "Business Analytics" before taking this course.

activityGoals.body: Be able to visualize given data to get appropriate findings
Be able to understand and explain the outline of deep learning techniques
Be able to apply a CNN (Convolutional Neural Networks) method for given image data
Be able to apply a RNN (Recurrent Neural Networks) method for given text data
Be able to apply an appropriate analytical method of to make predictions and classifications for given data
